wiki.title: Roger Williams (Texas politician)
wiki.extract: John Roger Williams (born September 13, 1949) is an American businessman and politician who has been the U.S. representative for Texas's 25th congressional district since 2013. A member of the Republican Party, he served as secretary of state of Texas from 2004 to 2007.
